summary: Frontend-only retest of the painted LifeTree background on overview '/' (admin@enfanceplus.fr). Painted bg [data-testid=tree-painted-bg] renders; the image loads (1264x848, no broken image); the old vector forest-depth/trunk is not in the DOM; the tree-frame::before blurred copy is applied so there are no hard black side bands at 1920. All 7 domain medallions are visible and their labels are readable over the painting. Clicking each medallion opens domain-detail-panel with the right title and zooms the camera; tree-back-button returns (14/14 clicks over 2 rounds). Sub-node chips (e1, c2, u1) open the domain panel containing the node title. Fragility nodes (6 present; anxiete/impulsivite/concentration tested) open the fragility panel. mode-simulation changes level pills to '→ x/5' and mode-comparaison to 'a → b'. detail-minus hides chips (28→0) and detail-plus restores them (28). filter-toggle-social hides the social branch. Mobile 390x844: painting and all 7 medallions render inside the frame, and tapping a medallion opens the panel. Regression: /domaine/cognitif, /enfants and /messages load. No page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicks on a medallion during the ~1s camera back-transition (right after '← Arbre complet') sometimes do nothing, because the medallion is still moving. They work every time once the transition settles. Low priority.

issues: The painting is letterboxed vertically, leaving blurred empty bands of about 40px at the top and 50px at the bottom of the frame
Sub-node chip text is about 5px and unreadable; chips at the left (Santé/Cognitif) and right (Social/Scolaire) edges are clipped by the frame. Consider hiding chips by default on mobile or zooming in

Fragility labels (Anxiété, Impulsivité, Concentration...) are pink/red text over a busy painted area and have weaker contrast than the domain labels. A dark stroke like the one on .branch-label would help
In fragility mode the 6 factor cards cover most of the painting (acceptable, just noting)

action_items: Optional: on mobile, use preserveAspectRatio slice/cover for the painting so it fills the frame height, and hide or enlarge the sub-node chips
Optional: add a dark text stroke to the fragility labels for contrast over the painting
critical_code_review_comments: The bounding box of the tree-domain-<id> <g> covers the whole transparent spine path (40px stroke), so its center often lands on empty svg. Automation should target [data-domain-target=<id>] (the r=60 hit circle). This is not a user bug.
In LifeTree.tsx, painted=true makes the whole !painted vector block dead code by default. Consider extracting it into a separate component to keep the file small.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (minor design notes only)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Click domain medallions at the center of [data-domain-target=<id>] and wait about 2.5s after zoom/back for the camera transition. Sub-node ids: e1..., c2, u1. Fragility ids: tree-frag-f-anxiete/impulsivite/concentration/sommeil/regulation/conflits. The fragility panel is an <aside> without a data-testid (consider adding one).
